question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH driver_constructor_year AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points, drv.constructor_id
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    JOIN drives drv ON r.year = drv.year AND ds.driver_id = drv.driver_id
),
driver_total_points AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, SUM(points) as driver_total_points
    FROM driver_constructor_year
    GROUP BY year, driver_id, constructor_id
),
best_driver_per_constructor AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, driver_id, driver_total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, constructor_id ORDER BY driver_total_points DESC) as rank
    FROM driver_total_points
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, driver_total_points as best_driver_points
    FROM best_driver_per_constructor
    WHERE rank = 1
),
constructor_yearly_total AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT bd.year, bd.constructor_id, bd.best_driver_points, cy.constructor_total_points,
           bd.best_driver_points + cy.constructor_total_points as combined_points
    FROM best_driver bd
    JOIN constructor_yearly_total cy ON bd.year = cy.year AND bd.constructor_id = cy.constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name as constructor_name, year, combined_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY combined_points DESC) as overall_rank
FROM combined
JOIN constructors c ON combined.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE c.name = 'Ferrari'
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 5
